2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "Horde" with the rest of our people.

248840|280b51d5.name: Trevan Rol
248840|280b51d5.text: In the darkest of nights, trust in the light to protect you. Of course, having a nice, sturdy mace doesn't hurt either.

248840|ed3d7580.name: Trevan Rol
248840|ed3d7580.text:
The Son of Arugal that attacked Lumina is known as Old Fire-Eye. He's not only well-known for his ferocity, but for his stubborn refusal to die. I've been doing a fair amount of research and I think that we can forge a blade that will do the trick and put him down for good.

Here, I've prepared a list of materials and information about how to get them for you. When you've gathered what we need, return to me and we'll get started.

259620|334a03a9.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|334a03a9.text:
When it was over I was stunned. He knew what would happen and he threw himself in front of that creature anyway to shield me.

We windshapers always pay our debts, and I owe him a debt. We've already avenged his death, but we can still avenge what was done to him by that monster, if you are still willing to lend me aid.

259620|5469c573.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|5469c573.text: There are no words to describe what happened. Banon twisted and contorted horribly. It sounded like every bone in his body was breaking. His mouth filled with razors and his hands became deadly claws. It took twenty gnolls to fell him, and he killed half of them before it was done.

259620|a831a213.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|a831a213.text:
As I said, the creature that attacked us fled when I singed its backside with lightning, but not before biting Banon. On our way back to town, the gnolls surrounded us and took us captive. 

It wasn't until they started to pull us out of the boat on Fenris Isle that... the change started.

3539|8259246a.name: Ott
3539|8259246a.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

91858-complete.name: Trevan Rol
91858-complete.text: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $c.
91858-complete.title: Diplomatic Incident

91862-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-complete.text: Thank you, $c. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.
91862-complete.title: Lumina Windsinger

96204-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-accept.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204-accept.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96204-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-complete.text:
Thank you again, $N. I've been acquainting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. I'm pleased that those insinuations are quite unfounded.

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
96204-complete.title: The Windshaper's Wrath
